pricing.details: Official structured prices from the Product/Offer JSON-LD on uxpilot.ai/plans only. Free Plan 0 € — 80 daily credits, one project, access to core design tools. Pro Plan 20 €/month — 750 monthly credits, unlimited projects, Website Cloner, credit top-ups. Teams Plan 28 € per user / month — per-user pricing, shared credits, collaboration features. Enterprise is custom. Other amounts that appear in comparison content on the same page were not used. A distinct yearly list price was not present in the official structured offers and is not listed.
pricing.label: Freemium
